mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 43 degrees and clear at Reddan Soccer Park. We have a waxing crescent moon, and the ISS will be visible tonight starting at 6:32 PM, rising in the west over Mount Horeb and traveling toward the northeast near the Home Depot, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The Plan Commission has several items on their agenda for the December 7th meeting, including plans for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park. Additionally, official notices for the upcoming elections are posted at City Hall.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today. You can also catch live music at Bailey's Run today and at Paddy Mac's today, while tomorrow features music at Lake Lou-ee and the John Denver tribute show at the high school.
In a recent report, officers responded on October 25th to a vehicle stopped at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, where a man was arrested for an O W I, his first offence.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10:30 PM today, and they are serving the delicious Caramel Cashew flavor of the day. Be sure to stop by and grab a scoop before they close for the night.
